channel.title: The Margin Wars | Basis-Point Watch [Preview]
channel.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review — official sources, practical moves.

item.title: Australia: audit the pass-through
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Cost direction: lower interchange; net savings unquantified. Method: Direction follows the RBA’s cap reductions. Merchant impact needs transaction mix and contracted pass-through; no basis-point estimate is claimed. The move: Reconcile October fees against September, holding card mix constant. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: NZ: price the commercial-card reset
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Cost direction: lower regulated interchange; merchant savings unquantified. Method: Direction follows the Commission’s decision. No conversion to merchant basis points without commercial-card share and acquirer terms. The move: Ask for an April repricing plan and a commercial-card mix report. Official source: https://www.comcom.govt.nz/regulated-industries/projects/interchange-fee-regulation/

item.title: UK: make fee evidence usable
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Impact direction: greater transparency; no guaranteed fee reduction. Method: Governance and disclosure duties do not themselves set merchant prices. No numeric savings estimate is claimed. The move: Build a fee-line inventory now; map each trigger to the acquiring invoice. Official source: https://www.psr.org.uk/publications/policy-statements/ps261-market-review-of-card-scheme-and-processing-fees-final-decision-information-transparency-and-complexity-remedy-pricing-governance-remedy/
